Also printed, and NOT configured as a modifier: "SPECIAL BLEND / Balanced Blend - Bluetamp (+30 THB) / Brazil, Columbia, Ethiopia / Modern Style (Medium Light Roasted) โดดเด่นในเรื่องของ Flavors และกลิ่น & รสผลไม้ตระกูลเบอร์รี่ มีบอดี้ที่มีความครีมมี่ จบด้วยช็อคโกแลตหวานๆ". The owner must say which coffees can take the +30 THB blend before it becomes an option. No Thai category label is printed.
bev-01, "HOT TEA | Rosemary Tea 140". Missing from data/menu.json and the reference site. No Thai category label is printed.

bev-02, heading "MILKY" under HOT / ICED columns; every HOT cell is a dash. data/menu.json flattened these to a single price. name_th is the reference site's translation; the scan prints no Thai category label.
bev-02, heading "SODA", one price per drink. name_th is the reference site's translation; the scan prints no Thai category label.

categories.name_th: น้ำผลไม้สด
categories.source_note: bev-02, heading "FRESH JUICE", one price per drink. Overlaps the separate JUICE list on bev-01 (category juice). name_th is the reference site's translation; the scan prints no Thai category label.

bev-01, heading "JUICE": Orange Juice 100, Coconut Water 100, Watermelon Juice 100, Mangosteen Juice 200. Missing from data/menu.json and the reference site. Two of its four entries repeat FRESH JUICE on bev-02, so it is unpublished until the owner says which list is current. No Thai category label is printed.

bev-04, heading "DRAFT BEER" with the printed line "PROMOTION  3 FREE 1". The promotion is recorded here only: it is not active and no discount is configured, because the eligible drinks, dates, size mixing, free-item choice, stacking and bill treatment are unconfirmed. The reference site paraphrased it as "Promotion — buy 3 get 1 free" / "โปรโมชั่น 3 แถม 1". Volumes are printed per drink as "( 250 ml. / 500 ml. )". name_th is the reference site's translation; the scan prints no Thai category label.
bev-04, heading "BOTTLED BEER". The reference site merged this with WHISKEY as "Bottled Beer & Spirits" / "เบียร์ขวดและสุรา"; name_th is the beer half of that site translation.
bev-04, heading "WHISKEY" with a single entry, Regency 550.- ( 350 ml. ). Printed as its own section; the reference site merged it into "Bottled Beer & Spirits". No Thai category label is printed.
bev-04, heading "SOFT DRINK". The reference site labelled it "เครื่องดื่ม", which is the same as the Drinks group name, so name_th is left empty until the owner supplies a Thai label.
